'''Ix Bantagash''' was a [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] found in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. There they met the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] spacer [[Fensi Moisk]], with whom they probably had a friendly relationship.<ref name="aotc exp vd">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref>
